description: This file defines React components related to displaying icons for players in a tic-tac-toe game, including accessible labels and SVG representations for players 'X' and 'O'. It includes documentation comments, import statements, and two main exported functions: iconLabelFor and PlayerIcon.

methods.name: iconLabelFor
methods.description: Returns an accessible label string for the given player symbol ('X' or 'O').

methods.name: PlayerIcon
methods.description: React component that renders an SVG icon representing the player ('X' or 'O') with appropriate accessibility labels.
